desc:
PROJECT FRONT UP - BETA

Full-physics bikelife. Wheelie, scrape and thread traffic for points. Motocross, electric, sport, scooter and MTB, each with its own weight, sound and feel.

Chase down combos, outrun the police and ride through tunnels at night with headlights blazing. Day/night cycle, stunt scoring with combo multipliers, mud spray and scrape sparks.

NEW: ride as your own avatar, paint every part, add decals, share paint and tricks on the Market, make your own tricks, swap tyres, ride pillion with friends.

KEYBOARD
W/S throttle/brake, A/D steer, Shift wheelie (hold in air = backflip), number keys for tricks, V camera, Z stand, C drag hand, P phone, M menu

CONTROLLER
R2 gas, L2 brake, sticks steer/cam, R1 wheelie and backflip, L1 parking brake, Y phone, D-pad L stand, D-pad R hand

MOBILE
On-screen controls appear while riding.

All assets original and owned by me. Copying means DMCA takedowns and bans.
